genres.description: Optional controlled list of genres, including subgenres. Known values form a controlled vocabulary that may grow; consumers MUST tolerate unknown values. Free-text subject tags are in the subjects field instead.

coverUri.description: Optional URL to a cover image for the work, hosted by the submitter. Runtime validation MUST restrict this to https:// URLs.

subjects.description: Optional free-text subject and topic tags.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with trailing Z when this record was created.

sourceUri.description: Optional URL to this work's page on the submitter's own site.

updatedAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with trailing Z when this record was last updated by republishing.

derivedFrom.description: Optional reference to the record this submission's data was derived from (e.g., a pub.byline.book record for Byline submissions). Carries no meaning to Dracome's ingestion; exists for downstream consumers to walk provenance.

description.description: Optional free-text description or summary of the work.

identifiers.description: Optional external identifiers (ISBN, Open Library key, etc.), plus the submitter's proprietary identifier (e.g. bylinePub, dracomeKey).

contributors.description: Required ordered list of credited contributors with roles, each carrying a resolvable profile reference.

firstPublicationDate.description: Optional original publication date of the work, at whatever precision is known (e.g., year only, or full date).

main.description: A submission record carrying candidate catalog data for a work, published by a trusted submitter to their own PDS. Repeatable; a submitter may create, update, or delete work-submission records over time.

cid.description: Optional content hash at time of derivation; informational only, detects drift.

nsid.description: Optional NSID of the referenced record's lexicon (e.g. 'pub.byline.book'); informational, since source shapes vary per trusted app.

derivedFromRef.description: A reference to the upstream record this submission's data was derived from. For Byline submissions, this points to the author's own pub.byline.book record. For direct Dracome submissions, derivedFrom is absent.
